description: Make another member of the document's Space the owner of the document. Use it when the reader asks to hand a document over, for example before they leave the Space. Only the current owner may do this, and the new owner must hold a role on the Space; a cohort reader does not count. Get the member's userId from spaces_get_space.

documentId.description: The document id, from tools_list_documents. Any builder's document.

name: spaces_transfer_document
title: Hand a document to another member of its Space
